records.title: Foundations of Large Language Model Compression - Part 1: Weight Quantization
records.reason: CVXQは凸最適化に基づく事後重み量子化を数百B規模へ適用し、任意のモデルサイズを指定できるとしており、LLMの保存量と配備計算量を直接下げる。

records.title: Reducing the Cost of Dropout in Flash-Attention by Hiding RNG with GEMM
records.reason: FlashAttentionのdropoutで支配的な乱数生成を先行GEMMと重ね、融合方式よりもLLM Transformer層の実行時間を短縮するカーネル手法。

records.title: SDQ-LLM: Sigma-Delta Quantization for 1-bit LLMs of any size
records.reason: Sigma-Delta量子化でLLM重みを1/1.58 bitに表現し、線形層の乗算を加算へ置き換えてモデル容量・推論計算を抑える。

records.title: DynamicAttention: Dynamic KV Cache for Disaggregate LLM Inference
records.reason: The IEEE conference program and DOI identify the Dynamic KV Cache paper, but the official Xplore abstract endpoint returned HTTP 418. Crossref REST DOI lookup was inaccessible through the available retrieval tool, so the publisher abstract could not be screened.

records.title: Beyond Sunk Costs: Boosting LLM Pre-training Efficiency via Orthogonal Growth of Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: 既存MoE checkpointを層の複製とノイズ付きexpert複製で直交拡張し、同じ追加計算予算で一から再学習するより高い事前学習効率を狙う。

records.title: Gradual Binary Search and Dimension Expansion : A general method for activation quantization in LLMs
records.reason: Hadamard回転と段階的二分探索で外れ値に対処し、LLMの重み・活性・KV cacheを3-bit化する量子化手法。

records.title: An Algorithm-Hardware Co-design Based on Revised Microscaling Format Quantization for Accelerating Large Language Models
records.reason: The official DAC program lists the matching paper and DOI; the IEEE Xplore abstract endpoint returned HTTP 418. Crossref REST DOI lookup was inaccessible through the available retrieval tool, so the publisher abstract could not be screened.

records.title: AsyncHZP: Hierarchical ZeRO Parallelism with Asynchronous Scheduling for Scalable LLM Training
records.reason: AsyncHZPはZeROの再shardと非同期all-gather/reduce-scatterを計算と重ね、巨大LLM学習時の通信待ちとメモリ負荷を抑える。

records.title: SD-Acc: Accelerating Stable Diffusion through Phase-Aware Sampling and Hardware Co-Optimizations
records.reason: 対象はStable Diffusionの画像生成で、位相別denoising近似と専用dataflowで画像品質を保ちながら計算・メモリアクセスを削減する。LLM推論・配備への接続は要旨に示されない。

records.title: ViM-VQ: Efficient Post-Training Vector Quantization for Visual Mamba
records.reason: ViM-VQは視覚タスク向けVisual Mambaの外れ値を処理する事後ベクトル量子化で、要旨の適用先・評価対象は視覚モデルに限られ、LLMシステム効率への具体的接続は示されない。

records.title: SparkAttention: high-performance multi-head attention for large models on Volta GPU architecture
records.reason: SparkAttentionはVolta Tensor Core向けにMHA学習カーネルを融合し、HBMアクセスを減らしてV100でPyTorch比1.80倍平均のTransformer学習高速化を報告する。

records.title: Harnessing the Unseen: The Hidden Influence of Intrinsic Knowledge in Long-Context Language Models
records.reason: この研究は長文脈LLMのparametric recallと外部検索能力の干渉を測る評価法を提案するが、計算量・メモリ・レイテンシ・配備効率を改善する手法は要旨にない。

records.title: CITR: Efficient Long Video Understanding Needs Causal Importance
records.reason: Bibliographic DOI/title match is confirmed in ACM Multimedia 2025 records, but the ACM Digital Library page returned HTTP 403 and the Crossref REST DOI lookup was inaccessible through the available retrieval tool. The primary abstract could not be screened.

records.title: Context-Aware Autoscaling for Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Inference With Prefix Cache Integration
records.reason: IEEE abstract describes AdaptiveScale using prefix-cache telemetry, heterogeneous tiered scheduling, and KV-state preservation for LLM serving; it reports reduced GPU costs while maintaining SLOs.

records.title: Challenging Quadratic Attention - A Holistic View On the Rise of Alternative Language Model Architectures
records.reason: The ACL abstract reviews sub-quadratic attention, recurrent/state-space, and hybrid architectures against compute and memory complexity, including domain-specific and edge-device settings.

records.title: From Static Inference to Dynamic Interaction: A Survey of Streaming Large Language Models
records.reason: The survey establishes a streaming-LLM taxonomy and analyzes methods across real-time text, speech, and video scenarios, directly addressing dynamic inference.

records.title: SUBLLM: A Novel Efficient Architecture with Token Sequence Subsampling for LLM
records.reason: SUBLLMはsubsampling・upsampling・bypassでデコーダ系列を短縮し、要旨では学習/推論の高速化とGPU当たりのメモリ削減を報告する。

records.title: Accelerating Attention with Basis Decomposition
records.reason: BD Attentionは基底分解による損失なしのattention再構成で、DeepSeek-V2-LiteのKV投影を高速化し重みも小さくする。

records.title: Speculative Verification: Exploiting Information Gain for Speculative Decoding
records.reason: The paper dynamically adapts speculative verification length using a companion model; its abstract reports higher throughput and up to 1.9x SD improvement.

records.title: Towards Optimal Placement of Deep Learning Tasks Over Edge and Cloud Infrastructures
records.reason: The verified survey formulates and compares edge/cloud placement objectives including inference latency, monetary cost, privacy, and resource constraints; these are concrete deployment-efficiency concerns.
